findings.artifact: catalog/tooling/parsers.py aidl(), member(); catalog/tooling/aidl_lex.py chunks(); catalog/tooling/build_catalog.py; catalog/tooling/validate_catalog.py
findings.evidence: aidl(): `chunks=[raw for raw,offset in aidl_chunks(body,';')]` then `member(raw,descriptor,pkg,True)`. aidl_lex.chunks splits only on ';' at bracket depth 0, so `parcelable P { int x; }` without trailing ';' merges with the following statement. member(): `a=body.index('(')...h=body[:a].strip()...ret=head_return(h[:m.start()].strip())` accepts a head containing '{' and '}' with no error, unlike aidl_members.field(): `if any(c in type_name for c in ';={}()'):raise ValueError`. No AIDL counterpart of the signature reconciliation guard exists in build_catalog or validate_catalog. hardware/interfaces is a selected project (project-coverage row [1293,1294], selected=true) and its stable HAL AIDL (for example android.hardware.audio.core.IModule) declares parcelables inside interface bodies before the methods using them. R7-02 only fixed top-level declarations.
findings.issue: A nested type followed by a method yields a single aidl-member whose return_type text is the whole nested body, reported as methods-parsed with no issue row, and the nested type receives no inventory entry. This fabricates metadata and silently drops declarations, contradicting the no-drop/visible-unknown principle, in both the candidate and release006.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: In parsers.aidl() interface path, pre-scan the body with a declaration-aware lexer (reuse aidl_lex.declaration_spans on the body) and emit each nested interface/parcelable/union/enum as its own declaration with descriptor '<outer>.<Name>' through enrich, removing its span before ';' chunking; as a guard, make member() raise ValueError when the head before '(' contains any of '{};' so any remaining merge becomes a visible unsupported record; add an AIDL reconciliation check (lexed declarations plus statements equal emitted records). Fixture: 'package a; interface I { parcelable P { int x; } void f(); }' expecting aidl:a.I, aidl:a.I.P (kind aidl-parcelable) and aidl:a.I#f() with return_type 'void'.
findings.verification_needed: New fixtures in a fresh regression receipt; read-only query over release006 counting aidl-member rows whose return_type contains '{' or 'parcelable '.

findings.evidence: `for simple,full in imports.items(): if full.startswith('java.lang.'):continue` skips every java.lang.* import including subpackages; qualify_anns() qualifies the same imports; jvm_source_link.encode() returns None for unqualified names.
findings.issue: Types imported from java.lang.reflect, java.lang.annotation or java.lang.ref stay unqualified in java-source canonical signatures, inconsistent with other explicit imports and blocking provable JVM links.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Change the skip to `if full=='java.lang.'+simple:continue`. Fixture: 'import java.lang.reflect.Method;' with 'void f(Method m)' expecting canonical a.C#f(java.lang.reflect.Method). Caches must be regenerated, not relabeled.

findings.evidence: Only active_imported_base_insert/update (on active_registry) compare base_record_hash. test_build inserts `(bid,bid,signature,1,None,None,'suppressed','{}',now,now)` with NULL base on a published database and succeeds. API-CONTRACT: 'Hash is the canonical effective imported document hash before local changes'; README: 'CAS constraints are executable'.
findings.issue: An imported overlay can be written with a NULL or stale base hash against the current active registry; the CAS invariant is enforced only at the next publication.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Add `CREATE TRIGGER overlay_base_current_insert BEFORE INSERT ON overlays WHEN new.imported_binding_id IS NOT NULL AND new.state IN ('active','suppressed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective_entries e WHERE e.entry_id=new.imported_binding_id AND e.record_sha256=new.base_record_hash) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Imported overlay base must match active entry'); END;` plus the UPDATE twin in schema.sql and migrations/002; update the test_build fixture to supply the current record_sha256 and registry id.
findings.verification_needed: DDL fixture rejecting NULL and stale bases; existing suites still pass.

findings.issue: Member types declared inside an interface or annotation without modifiers are recorded effective_visibility 'package' although they are implicitly public static.
